description:
FOUND 2026-08-17 while auditing what cargo package actually ships (op-mixd).

`diff crates/njoy-outram-park-fork/docs/api.md crates/njoy-outram-park-fork/docs/njoy-api.md` reports the files IDENTICAL. Both are 1.37 MB and both are inside the `include` allowlist (`docs/**`), so the published tarball carries the same generated rustdoc mirror twice -- 1.37 MB of the 10.8 MiB uncompressed package.

Largest packaged files measured 2026-08-17:
  4.48 MB  src/data/wmp_core.wmpl   (runtime data blob, legitimately needed)
  1.37 MB  docs/njoy-api.md         (duplicate)
  1.37 MB  docs/api.md              (the bookkeeping-pass target)
  0.17 MB  src/errorr/groups/tables.rs

DECISION NEEDED, not obvious enough to act on unilaterally:
  (a) delete njoy-api.md -- api.md is the name `kovan api-docs <crate>` writes and the one the bookkeeping pass regenerates, so njoy-api.md looks like a stale artifact of an earlier naming.
  (b) keep both but drop docs/ from the `include` allowlist, so the API mirror stays repo-only like the tapes now are. crates.io already renders rustdoc from source, so shipping a markdown mirror in the tarball buys a consumer little.

Either way it is a maintainer call about the published artifact, so this is filed rather than done. Package is comfortably under the limit today (5.8 MiB compressed), so there is no urgency.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content:
RESOLVED 2026-08-17, per maintainer direction: rename the mirror to <crate>-api.md everywhere rather than deleting either duplicate outright.

- kovan-cli's generate() and crates_in_scope() now write/look for docs/<crate_dir>-api.md.
- kovan-semantics' inventory() resolves the same. condense.rs/write_bundle needed no change -- they already went through CrateEntry.api_md.
- All 36 existing docs/api.md mirrors renamed and regenerated via kovan api-docs --all (installed rustdoc-md 0.2.0 + nightly, both genuinely absent from this sandbox, per the workspace's API-doc-toolchain hard rule).
- njoy-outram-park-fork/docs/njoy-api.md deleted after confirming it was byte-identical to the renamed njoy-outram-park-fork-api.md.
- README.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/raven-port-scoping.md updated to the new convention.

Verified: workspace check clean, kovan-cli 45 / kovan-semantics 42 tests passing, kovan api-docs --all reported 36/36 regenerated. Commit e407ae124d, pushed to develop.

Side note filed separately, not a defect: docs/raven-port-scoping.md's proposed crate name (outram-park-fork-raven) does not match the crate that was actually created (raffles, owned by Adolphus Lye) -- pre-existing drift, left alone since it's an unrelated naming question.

title: njoy: docs/api.md and docs/njoy-api.md are byte-identical -- 1.37 MB shipped twice in every tarball

notes.author: teddy0@snrsi-arch-desktop
notes.content:
PROGRESS 2026-08-04 (commit b44f549): TurbineVisual reworked and landed. Now renders ThreePhaseElectricGeneratorTurbine (tampines-steam-tables) with blades turning at theta = omega*t from its real explicit torque balance; state source is the TurbineVisualState enum (SteamGenerator / SteamThermo). Artwork ported from fhr_sim_v2 with two inherited defects fixed: hourglass silhouette -> monotonic inlet-to-exhaust blade growth, and width-vs-height-derived stroke widths -> everything derived from row pitch. Four tests pass. Driven from the new examples/widget_studio gallery app.

NEXT, requested by the maintainer 2026-08-04: ADD STATOR BLADES. Today only the ROTOR blades are drawn as moving marks; the stator rows are plain vertical bars standing in for the casing/annulus. A real multi-stage axial turbine alternates fixed stator (nozzle) rows with moving rotor rows, the stator turning the flow onto each rotor row. So stator rows should carry their own fixed blades, angled opposite to the rotor blades and NOT animated, making the stage structure legible.

Still outstanding after that: size is proportional to the widget box, not to any real machine dimension -- that remains blocked on op-dt3.17.1 (tampines Turbine casing/envelope dimensions), and casing colour stays absent until a steam path exists (op-dt3.18).

title: Widget Studio QC: TurbineVisual — single rect, colour-only
